c74object.name: el.bvplay~
c74object.digest: Note-driven buffer player with linear interpolation and envelope tapering
c74object.description: el.bvplay~ plays regions of an MSP buffer~ based on incoming list messages. It applies a linear envelope (taper) to the start and end of each note.

inlet.description: Trigger a note. List format: [start_ms, duration_ms, increment, amplitude].

outlet.description: Audio output for channel 2 (if initialized for stereo).

objarg.name: buffername
objarg.description: The name of the target buffer~.

objarg.name: channels
objarg.description: The expected number of channels in the buffer (1 or 2).

objarg.name: taper
objarg.description: Default fade time in milliseconds (default: 10.0 ms).

method.name: list
method.description: Triggers a single note playback based on the provided list.

method.name: taper
method.description: Sets the ramp time in milliseconds for the envelope.

method.name: verbose
method.description: When enabled, posts error messages to the Max console if notes are out of bounds.

attribute.name: taper
attribute.description: The default ramp duration applied to notes in milliseconds.
